title: Flatten a Multilevel Doubly Linked List
description: Flatten a multilevel doubly linked list so that all nodes appear in a single-level doubly linked list using DFS.
pseudocode:
1: function flatten(head):
2:   curr = head
3:   while curr:
4:     if curr.child:
5:       next = curr.next
6:       child = flatten(curr.child)
7:       curr.next = child
8:       child.prev = curr
9:       curr.child = null
10:      tail = child
11:      while tail.next: tail = tail.next
12:      tail.next = next
13:      if next: next.prev = tail
14:    curr = curr.next
